name: tbf-stp-fit
about: Two STP bridges on one cable; S1's port is shaped with a queue of 52 bytes, exactly the size of a config BPDU (14 Ethernet + 3 LLC + 35), so every BPDU gets through. Hello time 1.5 s; the first action skips the start-up BPDUs and the second spans exactly two hello periods, so the BPDU count does not depend on the phase of the kernel's hello timer.
